strategy.name: Strategy & project plan
strategy.scope: A workshop of up to 90 minutes, a review of one offer and your current enquiry process, and a written plan of priorities. Website builds and campaign setup are separate.
strategy.scope_hr: Razgovor do 90 minuta o jednoj ponudi i upitima. Dobivate pisani plan prioriteta.

packages.label: 01 / WEBSITE + ENQUIRIES
packages.name: Website & enquiries
packages.description: Explain your offer clearly and give customers a useful way to get in touch.
scope: Offer and customer journey plan for one audience
Up to 5 pages or one landing page, in one language
One form with qualifying questions, delivered to your inbox
Basic technical SEO and editing of the content you supply
Measurement plan for up to 3 actions and 2 rounds of revisions
packages.note: Ad setup and CRM integrations are quoted separately.
packages.summary: Up to 5 pages + one enquiry form.
packages.description_hr: Nova stranica ili redizajn. Ponuda, radovi i kontakt na jednom mjestu.
scope_hr: Plan ponude i puta do kontakta za jednu skupinu kupaca
Do 5 stranica ili jedna odredišna stranica, na jednom jeziku
Jedan obrazac s pitanjima za pripremu ponude, dostava na e-mail
Osnovni tehnički SEO i uređenje sadržaja koji dostavite
Plan mjerenja do 3 radnje i ukupno 2 kruga izmjena

packages.label: 02 / WEBSITE + ADS
packages.name: Website & ads
packages.description: Get your website, first ad campaigns and enquiry tracking ready to work together.
scope: Everything in Website & enquiries, with up to 8 pages in total
One campaign landing page within that page allowance
Initial Google Ads or Meta Ads setup, with up to 2 campaigns
Tracking for up to 5 actions and consent management setup
Checks from ad click to enquiry, plus instructions for monitoring
packages.note: Monthly management and ad spend are separate.
packages.summary: Up to 8 pages + initial setup of one ad channel.
packages.description_hr: Web i priprema kampanja za Google ili Metu.
packages.summary_hr: Do 8 stranica i početno postavljanje jednog oglasnog kanala.
scope_hr: Sve iz paketa Web, do ukupno 8 stranica
Jedna stranica za kampanju unutar tog broja stranica
Početno postavljanje Google ili Meta oglasa, do 2 kampanje
Praćenje do 5 radnji i postavljanje upravljanja privolama
Provjera puta od oglasa do poslanog upita i upute za praćenje

packages.label: 03 / WEBSITE + CUSTOM TOOLS
packages.name: Website & custom tools
packages.description: Help buyers work out what they need, or connect enquiries to the way you manage sales.
scope: Everything in Website & ads, with up to 10 pages in total
One configurator or calculator with up to 8 input parameters
Or one CRM integration with up to 2 automated workflows, instead of the configurator
Testing of the agreed workflow and handover documentation
One training session of up to 60 minutes; 2 rounds of revisions in total
packages.note: A configurator and CRM together, extra integrations or more complex calculations need a separate quote.
packages.summary: Up to 10 pages + a configurator or one CRM integration.
packages.description_hr: Konfigurator, kalkulator ili veza s CRM-om za složeniju prodaju.
packages.summary_hr: Do 10 stranica i konfigurator ili jedna CRM integracija.
scope_hr: Sve iz paketa Web i kampanje, do ukupno 10 stranica
Jedan konfigurator ili kalkulator s do 8 ulaznih podataka
Ili jedna CRM integracija s do 2 automatizirana postupka, umjesto konfiguratora
Jedna edukacija do 60 minuta; ukupno 2 kruga izmjena

monthly.name: Technical care
monthly.scope: One website: health checks, backups where supported, updates and up to 30 minutes of small changes.
monthly.scope_hr: Jedan web: provjere, sigurnosne kopije gdje su podržane, ažuriranja i do 30 minuta dorada.

monthly.name: SEO development
monthly.scope: One website: monthly priorities, improvements to up to 2 existing pages and a summary. New copy is agreed separately.
monthly.scope_hr: Jedan web, do 2 postojeće stranice mjesečno i pregled. Novi tekstovi zasebno.

monthly.name: Google Ads or Meta Ads
monthly.scope: One account on one channel, with up to 3 active campaigns: monitoring, optimisation and a monthly review.
monthly.scope_hr: Jedan kanal i račun: do 3 kampanje, dorade i mjesečni pregled.

monthly.name: Both ad channels
monthly.scope: Google Ads and Meta Ads, with up to 5 active campaigns in total and a combined monthly review.
monthly.scope_hr: Oba kanala, do 5 kampanja ukupno i mjesečni pregled.

monthly.name: Ongoing development
monthly.scope: Website improvements, SEO and management of up to 2 ad channels in an agreed plan of up to 16 hours a month; up to 5 campaigns in total.
monthly.scope_hr: Web, SEO, do 2 kanala: do 16 sati i do 5 kampanja mjesečno.
